- Outcome: execute and lock automated appearance, accessibility, localization, and candidate-vs-S9 visual evidence for every frozen common task and released state against the exact migrated product.
- Exact delta: automated verification and evidence only. Ordinary S10.4 E may add only the bounded unit/UI lab tests; it may not change app/product/project/asset/fixture bytes. A diagnosed S10.2/S10.3 defect is a fail-closed hold until CURRENT_TASK names the exact introducing path for the smallest in-place correction; the unchanged S10.4 selector must then re-prove the complete matrix.
- GOLDEN: all `67 × 14 = 938` frozen visual requirement cells have exact screenshot/hash/AX/contrast evidence; all `6 × 2 × 7 = 84` common-task/device/accessibility rows have a closed automated disposition; brand assets render; common tasks complete; and every candidate-vs-S9 comparison is human-reviewed without replacing the approved S9 baseline bytes.

- ALT-1: a missing/duplicate matrix cell, unresolved `NOT_RUN`, overflow/crop, contrast/44-point target/focus/order/localization/RTL/pseudolanguage failure, stale or unbound screenshot, wrong candidate head, unreviewed delta, baseline replacement, invented reviewer, or flaky route fails closed and triggers the smallest causal correction rather than a waiver.
